description: Three independent fresh native processes, each carrying one four-turn everyday lunch-planning conversation in live KV. Synthetic user constraints, no imported parent or policy attachment.

turns.user: I'm making lunch for three with rice, chickpeas, and spinach. One guest avoids peanuts. Suggest a simple dish in two short sentences.
I only have 25 minutes and one pan. Can you adapt that lunch so I can actually make it in time?
One guest also avoids dairy. What extra ingredients, if any, should I buy on a small budget?
Thanks. Summarize the final plan and all the food and time constraints in a short checklist.

semantic_review.lunch_idea: Uses the available rice, chickpeas, spinach; no peanut-containing recommendation.
semantic_review.time_and_pan: Adapts to one pan and 25 minutes, preserving the peanut restriction and using feasible ready-to-cook ingredients.
semantic_review.dairy_and_budget: Retains peanut restriction, adds dairy avoidance, suggests only modest missing ingredients and no expensive or time-intensive substitution.
semantic_review.final_plan: Recalls three people, rice/chickpeas/spinach, peanut-free and dairy-free guest, one pan, 25 minutes, and budget-minded shopping without contradicting earlier turns.

state_contract: Greedy with no seed; require identical input/output IDs, rendered text, finish reasons, positions, complete state/facts/payload/canonical SHA after the same four turns across three fresh processes. Keep live KV in one session across turns; export only after the final answer, separately timed and deleted after exact verification.
limits: One ROCm host and one synthetic conversation; no cross-platform or multi-user guarantee
Model stops naturally below O192 when possible; cap closure is a semantic partial, not a forced four-turn PASS
Native startup, state export, and cleanup excluded from per-request HTTP wall; OS page-cache warmth can vary across repeats
No CTX12288 parent import into CTX4096
